_doc: Schedule-matched vs distribution-matched gap augmentation, on ONE training pool (local, M5).
note: single-factor contrasts: rand vs rand_norelabel (relabel), rand_norelabel vs sched_norelabel (first-season mask), rand_norelabel vs sched_seasons (measured seasons); shipped/ft_g08e12 are reference rows trained on other pools. rmdc26_schedule = first-season mask + season end; rmdc26_seasons = measured per-season templates.

legacy_relabel_exposure.note: eligible = all three bins around the recorded onset are blanked by the first-season mask; the relabel fires only on presentations that draw the gap augmentation (p=0.8) and still carry NonPSPL after the truncation step (p=0.5), so the per-presentation rate is lower than this fraction

gulls._doc: GULLS/RMDC26 summary tables across checkpoints, from the per-event rows -- one command, no typing.

sample.weights: RMDC26 final_weight (event rate); 'weighted' blocks use it, every other number is per simulated event
